name: mlb-pitch-recognition
description: MLB pitch recognition system with web and mobile applications

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:mobile"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:mobile
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:mobile
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check:web && npm run type-check:shared
scripts.type-check:web: cd webapp && npm run type-check || echo 'Web type-check not available'
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd webapp && npm install && cd ../mobile && npm install && cd ../shared && npm install
scripts.clean: rm -rf webapp/node_modules mobile/node_modules shared/node_modules node_modules webapp/.next mobile/.expo shared/dist

author: Your Name
